propositions: A hard clarity floor must reject acceptance criteria checkbox items containing only whitespace after the marker, as empty criteria cannot name an executable outcome.

Unresolved sentinel values (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) occupying structural assignment positions in Approach/Scope/Testing/Acceptance Criteria sections (outside code fences) constitute a hard floor violation, with removal/negation assertions suppressed.
Exact duplicate acceptance criteria items, though redundant, do not make a plan ambiguous and should not hard-fail clarity scoring; they are advisory coaching only.

[rebar:<id>] prerequisite citations used as plain provenance or downstream scope references are inert to grounding validation; direct-edge checking applies only when claiming a prerequisite will create an absent file/symbol.
Malformed file-impact structured entries (missing path or reason) belong to write-schema validation at the mutation boundary, not plan clarity scoring.

Five historical counterexamples (8d27-7ee1-f137-4b88, c244-ba53-6280-4702, 6673-7636-a116-4f90, 94f9-a9a0-7475-4e75, and negative control examples) validate the narrowed hard floor and disprove naive broad rules.
